config:
# travel-mode 配置模板
[apps]
default = "ask"
watch = ["Google Chrome", "Slack"]
ignore = []
quit = ["Spotify"]
freeze = ["WeChat"]
skip = ["Raycast"]
ask = ["Visual Studio Code"]

[[apps.with_daemon]]
name = "Remote Support"
system_daemons = ["/Library/LaunchDaemons/example.daemon.plist"]
user_agents = ["/Library/LaunchAgents/example.agent.plist"]
group = "network"

[network]
apps = ["Tailscale"]

[services]
unload = []
keep = []

[power.battery]
# displaysleep = 3

[categories]
# Category actions supplement services.unload and apps actions; keep/skip take priority.
pause = ["sync", "backup", "updater"]
# Match a rule id or its public product name.
ignore = []

[options]
aggressive = false
language = "auto"
# Ask at startup, or choose work / away. --scenario and --profile skip the picker.
scenario = "ask"

[profiles.flight]
# Add profile-specific values in a future release.

# Optional event agent is installed only by automation install.
[automation]
on_battery = "notify"
on_ac = "notify"
retain = 50
